newsitem.title: UK: London stocks advance on hopes for prudent budget.
newsitem.headline: London stocks advance on hopes for prudent budget.

text.p: UK stocks ended firmer on Monday as momentum from the FTSE's dramatic rise on Friday continued amid subsiding fears of an inflationary budget Tuesday, and after Wall Street stocks reached their latest record peak.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares added another 35.9 points to finish at 4,054.6, within reach of its all-time record 4,073.2 set on October 21. "It is incredible coming after Friday's move," said one trader. "The momentum has just carried on."
But a challenge for the record always looked unlikely as caution set in ahead of Tuesday's budget, despite growing optimism over the possibility of a tight fiscal package.
